cases.input: A worker leaves an HR-manager position and two grants are explicitly conditioned on that assignment.
cases.expect: Those grants and their derived delegations become unsatisfied and are revoked effective at the assignment change.

cases.input: The same worker has a separately justified incident-response grant not conditioned on the former position.
cases.expect: The grant remains subject to review and is not revoked by automatic position propagation.

cases.input: A source grant covers read and update on all region-A records for 30 days; a child grants read on one dataset for 7 days.
cases.expect: The child is valid, cites the source and remains within actions, scope and validity.

cases.input: An employee title alone creates an IAM role assignment and permission grant.
cases.expect: The grant is rejected because organizational position is context, not authorization authority.

cases.input: A delegated grant adds delete permission and outlives its source grant.
cases.expect: The delegation is rejected for violating action and validity attenuation.

cases.input: Consent to disclose one record is treated as general write access to the system.
cases.expect: The capability is rejected because consent and IAM authorization are separate instruments.

cases.input: A credential record stores an API secret and a reversible digest in a projection.
cases.expect: The record and projection are rejected; only protected references and safe metadata are permitted.
